item.text: At dawn, the ferry moved steadily across grey water, its low hum blending with the quiet of the deck. I held warm bread in a paper bag, letting the heat reach my hands through the thin paper. Nearby, a child counted the buoys as they slipped past, starting over whenever the rhythm broke. Ahead, the far shore appeared almost reluctantly, its outline sharpening so slowly that it felt less like arrival than waking.
